202private:
203 // Debounce TS apply events to coalesce short bursts into one operation
204 // and avoid repetitive bridge/VLAN reconfiguration churn.
205 static constexpr int DEBOUNCE_MS = 200;
206 // Newly learned WDS netdevs may appear and become runnable shortly after
207 // the property notification is emitted, so keep the first add attempt
208 // out of the synchronous event path.
209 static constexpr int WDS_SETTLE_MS = 500;
210 // Keep retrying for a bounded window so the same WDS iface is not lost if
211 // it becomes ready shortly after the settle delay.
212 static constexpr int WDS_RETRY_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;
